participantProgram.title: Program Information
participantProgram.noProgram: You are not enrolled in a program yet.
participantProgram.noSchedule: The program calendar will appear here once the organization sets the dates.
participantProgram.intro: {program}, organized by {org}, is designed for university students who want to grow in entrepreneurship and innovation, gain new skills and put what they learn into practice through real scenarios.
participantProgram.during: Throughout the program you will take part in training on {content}, make decisions in different simulations, work on solving problems and experience the different stages of the entrepreneurial world.
participantProgram.certificateNote: When you complete the program successfully, you will earn the {certificate} certificate. You will also be able to track your development through the work and assessments you complete along the way.
participantProgram.cta1: This is not just a training program. It is a journey where you will discover yourself, test your ideas and experience the world of entrepreneurship.
participantProgram.cta2: Sometimes you will make the right call, sometimes you will be wrong, and sometimes you will find a solution you never thought of. The goal is not to get everything right the first time; it is to think, try, learn and grow.
participantProgram.cta3: If you are ready, let us start by discovering your potential. Your first step is waiting.
